market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI active month around $94.40 with last week intraday low ~$92.68. The April market needs any 1m candle to print <= $90 by April 30, requiring roughly a 4.7% drop from spot. With Iran diplomacy risk pulling both ways and only ~3 trading days left, downside touches happen but require de-escalation. Base rate plausible but not majority.
assessment.key_uncertainty: A breakthrough US-Iran diplomatic move in the next few sessions could quickly bring WTI under $90.
